protocol.primary_quality_metric: latent regret of the configuration selected by minimum observed value
protocol.initialization_comparison: random/proxy/gp share random warmup; ax/ax_sobol share Sobol warmup
protocol.memory_metric: OS child high-water RSS (largest process, not simultaneous process-tree sum)
protocol.execution: fresh controller process per suggest/ingest; shared OS caches; sequential trials

limitations: Synthetic sequential workloads; no production or asynchronous performance claims.
Seed-level median/IQR is descriptive; no statistical significance or universal superiority claim.
Initialization policies differ; comparisons include their effects.
Best observed noisy scores can be optimistic; selected latent regret is the primary quality measure.
Fresh process overhead includes imports; OS caches and concurrent cases are shared.
RSS is an OS child high-water mark, not simultaneous aggregate memory or GPU memory.

provenance.source_identification: working-tree SHA256 hashes in protocol; commit identifies the baseline
